description: Known interdisciplinary discoveries for bootstrap calibration
note: SPORE should 'rediscover' at least 7/10 of these bridges

discoveries.name: Quasicrystals
discoveries.expected_bridge: Aperiodic tiling patterns (Penrose tiles) explain diffraction patterns with forbidden symmetries

discoveries.name: Shape Memory Alloys
discoveries.expected_bridge: Martensitic phase transformations enable reversible shape changes through temperature or stress

discoveries.name: Biomimetic Nacre
discoveries.expected_bridge: Hierarchical brick-and-mortar architecture from nacre provides exceptional toughness to ceramic composites through crack deflection and energy dissipation

discoveries.name: Graphene from Graphite
discoveries.expected_bridge: Mechanical exfoliation using adhesive tape exploits weak van der Waals forces between graphite layers to produce atomically thin graphene sheets

discoveries.name: High-Entropy Alloys
discoveries.expected_bridge: Configurational entropy stabilizes single-phase solid solutions with multiple principal elements

discoveries.name: Perovskite Solar Cells
discoveries.expected_bridge: Halide perovskites transfer from ceramic/oxide research to photovoltaics, combining solution processability with exceptional carrier lifetimes and absorption coefficients

discoveries.name: Self-Healing Polymers
discoveries.expected_bridge: Microencapsulated healing agents enable autonomous crack repair in polymer matrices

discoveries.name: MOFs for Gas Storage
discoveries.expected_bridge: Tunable pore chemistry and ultra-high surface area enable selective gas capture and storage

discoveries.name: Topological Insulators
discoveries.expected_bridge: Band inversion and spin-orbit coupling create conducting surface states protected by topology

discoveries.name: Additive Manufacturing of Metals
discoveries.expected_bridge: Extreme cooling rates in laser powder bed fusion create non-equilibrium microstructures with supersaturated compositions and refined grain structures impossible through conventional casting
